auth.invalid_credentials: That login handle and password were not accepted.
auth.session_expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

application.workspace_description: Review applications within your agency and open a record to inspect its decision history.
application.search_description: Search by application ID, processing code, or current status.
application.no_results_description: Try a different application ID, processing code, or status.
application.no_applications_description: Applications assigned to your agency will appear here.
application.load_error: We could not load the applications for this agency.
application.no_history: No status history is available for this application yet.
application.identifier_unavailable: Open action unavailable: the edge record has no application identifier
application.partial_description: The edge returned the application projection, but its history was not an array. Review the application fields and try again before taking action.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Unable to connect. Check your internet connection.
errors.not_found: This record could not be found.
errors.forbidden: You don't have permission to perform this action.
errors.validation: Please fix the errors below before continuing.

offline.banner: You're offline. Changes will sync when you reconnect.
offline.sync_unavailable: Score captures stay on this device. Uploading them to the recruitment record is not available yet, so do not wipe or hand off this tablet before an officer confirms the scores were transferred.
offline.nothing_sent: Nothing is sent or saved while there is no connection: the gate, the walk-in desk and every officer action need the edge. Wait for the connection to return, or follow the paper procedure.

biometric_consent.title: Biometric Data Collection Consent
biometric_consent.body: By proceeding, you consent to {{agencyName}} collecting and processing your biometric data (fingerprints, facial image) for the USRP recruitment process. Your data will be handled in strict accordance with applicable data protection regulations.
biometric_consent.audio_label: Listen to this consent in Kinyarwanda

officer_actions.reject_confirm_body: Are you sure you want to reject this application? This action cannot be undone.
officer_actions.action_completed_description: The application has been updated. The record and its queues are being refreshed.
officer_actions.conflict: The application changed before this action completed
officer_actions.conflict_description: Refresh the record and confirm the current status before trying again.
officer_actions.no_change_description: The backend reported NO_CHANGE. The record was refreshed so you can review its current state.
officer_actions.transition_receipt: Backend outcome: {{outcome}}. From status: {{fromStatus}}. Projected status: {{status}}.
officer_actions.no_permission: Your role can view this application but not decide it.

scan.no_camera: Camera not available on this device. Please enter the code manually.
scan.camera_error: Could not access camera. Please enter the code manually.
scan.fallback_placeholder: Paste or type the QR code value

upload.drop_hint: Drop files here, or click to select

applicant.no_applications: You have no applications on file.

apply.title: Submit an application
apply.category_help: Choose a recruitment category. The backend derives the responsible agency from this choice.
apply.agency_derived: This category is handled by {{agency}}. You do not need to select or submit an agency.
apply.education_help: Enter the {{registry}} reference for this category. This is the only academic field the backend requires for the selected category.
apply.declaration_copy: I declare that the information I provide is true and accurate. This acknowledgement is local to this form; the backend submission contains only the supported category and academic reference fields.
apply.listen_declaration_hint: Listen to this declaration in Kinyarwanda.
apply.review_body: Submitting sends only the category and its required academic reference through the applicant session. The backend decides the application record and status.
apply.success_body: The backend accepted your application. Your current citizen application list has been refreshed; no application details are inferred from this response.
apply.replay_body: The backend replayed the earlier filing for this idempotency key. Your current citizen application list has been refreshed.
apply.validation_body: The backend rejected the submission fields or idempotency key. Review the form and try again.
apply.duplicate_body: The backend reports that you already have an application for this recruitment opportunity. Your application list is the source of truth.
apply.conflict_body: The backend cannot accept this submission in the current state.

conflicts.IDENTITY_NOT_VERIFIED: Your applicant identity must be verified before you submit.
conflicts.NO_OPEN_CAMPAIGN: There is no open recruitment campaign for this category.
conflicts.AGE_PENDING: Your age eligibility is still being checked.
conflicts.CROSS_AGENCY_ACCEPT_LOCK: This submission is blocked by an existing acceptance lock.
conflicts.ILLEGAL_TRANSITION: The backend cannot accept this submission in its current state.

apply.offline_body: Your draft remains on this device. Filing requires a connection to the applicant edge; no submission was sent.
apply.dependency_title: A required service is temporarily unavailable
apply.dependency_body: The backend could not reach a required service. Your draft remains on this device; try again later.
apply.session_body: Your applicant session has ended or is not available. Sign in again before submitting.
apply.forbidden_body: The backend refused this session or its CSRF protection. Sign in again and try once more.
apply.rate_limit_body: Please wait before trying to submit again.
apply.campaign_error_body: Check your connection and try again.
apply.campaign_none_title: No recruitment is open right now
apply.campaign_none_body: There is no campaign open for registration at the moment. Please check again later, or follow the official announcements.
apply.campaign_help: Choose the recruitment you are applying to.
apply.documents_help: Upload each document as a PDF, JPEG or PNG. A document is only received here — it is checked later, and you will not see a result on this screen.
apply.document_file_label: File (PDF, JPEG or PNG, up to 10 MB)
apply.upload_error: The document could not be uploaded. Check the file and try again.
apply.upload_ok_body: Received: {{types}}. You can upload another document.

upload_refusals.APPLICATION_NOT_FOUND: We could not find this application.
upload_refusals.NOT_ACCEPTING_DOCUMENTS: This application is not accepting documents at this stage.
upload_refusals.UNSUPPORTED_DOCUMENT_TYPE: This document type is not accepted for your recruitment.
upload_refusals.UNSUPPORTED_FILE_CONTENT: This file is not a readable PDF, JPEG or PNG.
upload_refusals.UNSUPPORTED_FILE_TYPE: Only PDF, JPEG and PNG files are accepted.
upload_refusals.CONTENT_TYPE_MISMATCH: The file does not match its declared type.
upload_refusals.DOCUMENT_REJECTED_MALWARE: This file was refused because it may be unsafe. Please scan your device and use a clean copy.
upload_refusals.FILE_TOO_LARGE: This file is too large (maximum 10 MB).

exam_qr.title: My exam QR code
exam_qr.ready_title: Your exam QR code is ready
exam_qr.ready_body: Download or print this QR code and bring it, with your National ID, to the physical screening. Officers scan it at the gate.
exam_qr.download_failed: The image could not be created in this browser. Use Print instead, or take a screenshot.
exam_qr.present_at_gate: Present this code with your National ID at the screening gate.
exam_qr.keep_private: This code is your personal invitation. Do not share it.
exam_qr.not_found: We could not find this application among yours.
exam_qr.load_failed: Your QR code could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
exam_qr.unavailable_title: Your QR code is not available
exam_qr.unavailable_body: Your exam slot is assigned but the code is not ready yet. Please check again later or contact the agency.

PENDING.title: Your application is being checked
PENDING.body: Your QR code will appear here automatically as soon as your eligibility checks pass and your exam slot is assigned. You can keep this page open.

ON_HOLD.title: Your application is under review
ON_HOLD.body: An officer is reviewing your application. Your QR code is withheld until the review is completed.

COMPLETED.title: Your screening is complete
COMPLETED.body: The examination stage of your application is finished; no QR code is needed any more.

CLOSED.title: No QR code for this application
CLOSED.body: This application is no longer active, so there is no exam invitation.

EXPIRED.title: This QR code has expired
EXPIRED.body: The exam day for this invitation has passed.

UNAVAILABLE.title: Your QR code is not available yet
UNAVAILABLE.body: Your exam slot is assigned but the code is not ready yet. Please check again later or contact the agency.

WALK_IN.title: Walk-in registration
WALK_IN.body: You were registered on site on exam day, so there is no QR invitation.

ADMITTED.title: You have been admitted
ADMITTED.body: Your QR code was used at {{venue}} on {{time}}. It cannot be used again.

gate.title: Venue gate
gate.intro: Scan the candidate's exam QR, check their national ID card in person, then admit. Each QR admits one person, once.
gate.venue_help: Exactly as printed on the candidates' invitations. Remembered on this device.
gate.qr_help: Scan with the camera, or with a hand-held scanner into this field.
gate.nid_help: 16 digits typed from the physical card. Checked against the application, never stored.
gate.nid_invalid: A national ID number has 16 digits.
gate.no_permission_title: Your role cannot admit at the gate
gate.no_permission_body: Gate admission is reserved for the screening post.
gate.failed_title: Not admitted — the server could not be reached
gate.failed_body: Nothing was recorded. Check the connection and try again.

ADMITTED.title: Admitted
ADMITTED.body: {{code}} · {{category}} — report by {{hour}}. This QR is now used.

ALREADY_ADMITTED.title: QR already used — do not admit
ALREADY_ADMITTED.body: This QR was used at {{venue}} at {{time}}{{by}}. Refer the candidate to the supervisor.

IDENTITY_MISMATCH.title: ID card does not match — do not admit
IDENTITY_MISMATCH.body: The national ID on the card is not the applicant of {{code}}. The attempt is recorded.

WRONG_VENUE.title: Wrong venue
WRONG_VENUE.body: This QR is for {{venue}}. Direct the candidate there.

TOO_EARLY.title: Not today
TOO_EARLY.body: This QR is for the exam on {{date}}.

EXPIRED.title: QR expired
EXPIRED.body: The exam day for this QR ({{date}}) has passed.

MANUAL_IDENTITY_REQUIRED.title: A supervisor must confirm identity
MANUAL_IDENTITY_REQUIRED.body: The card matched, but the evidence for {{code}} needs a field supervisor. Do not admit until the supervisor confirms.

invalid_reasons.MALFORMED_TICKET: This is not an exam QR code.
invalid_reasons.WRONG_AGENCY: This QR is for another agency's exam.
invalid_reasons.UNKNOWN_TICKET: No application of this agency matches this QR.
invalid_reasons.TICKET_NOT_ISSUED: This QR was not issued by the system: it may be altered or forged.

walk_in.category_help: Only your agency's categories are listed. The academic reference it needs appears after you choose.
walk_in.academic_help: This category needs the candidate's {{registry}} reference. The registry check runs after registration.

refusals.INVALID_ACADEMIC_INPUT: The academic reference is missing or not valid for this category. Check the {{registry}} number and try again.
refusals.NO_WALK_IN_CAMPAIGN: There is no open campaign that accepts walk-ins for your agency today. Registration cannot continue at this venue.
refusals.ALREADY_APPLIED: This candidate already has an application in this campaign ({{processingCode}}). Continue with that application instead.
refusals.WRONG_AGENCY_CATEGORY: That category belongs to another agency. Choose one of your agency's categories.
refusals.IDENTITY_NOT_VERIFIED: The identity check has not completed for this candidate. Run the identity check again.
refusals.APPLICANT_NOT_FOUND: The identity record was not found. Run the identity check again.
refusals.UNSUPPORTED_AGENCY: Walk-in registration is only available for RDF campaigns.
refusals.FORBIDDEN: Your role cannot register walk-in candidates.
refusals.VALIDATION_FAILED: The registration details were not accepted. Check each field and try again.

rehearsal.apply_notice: Rehearsal campaign: practice only. It is not a real recruitment and no one is enlisted from it.
rehearsal.pass_body: This pass belongs to a rehearsal. It is practice only and is not valid for any real recruitment.

readiness.not_built_body: This screen is at readiness rung {{rung}} ({{surface}}). Production builds do not include it.
readiness.undeclared_body: No surface manifest declares this route, so production builds do not include it.
readiness.not_found_body: This page is not part of this version of the app.

field_station.stations_intro: Only the stations your role allows are listed. Ask your supervisor if yours is missing.
field_station.no_stations_body: Your role does not include an exam-day station. Use the Officer Console instead.

gate.title: Venue gate
gate.body: Scan the exam QR and admit each candidate once.

documents.title: Paper documents
documents.body: Record each required paper document seen at the venue.

physical.title: Physical test
physical.body: Capture one candidate's physical test results at a time.

medical.title: Medical
medical.body: Record the medical review in your agency's mode.

walk_in.title: Walk-in desk (RDF)
walk_in.body: Verify, register and vet walk-in candidates.

supervisor.title: Supervisor
supervisor.body: Review sync status and resolve capture conflicts.

field_station.moved_title: This screen has moved to the Field Station
field_station.moved_body: The venue gate and the walk-in desk now run on the Field Station, the exam-day tablet app. Open it on the station device to continue.
field_station.station_unavailable_title: This station is not available for your account
field_station.station_unavailable_body: Your role or agency does not include this station. Choose one of your stations instead.

loading.title: Loading
loading.body: Please wait while the data is retrieved.

empty.title: Nothing here yet
empty.body: There are no records to show.

filtered-empty.title: No matching records
filtered-empty.body: No record matches the current search or filters.

forbidden.title: Not permitted
forbidden.body: Your post does not allow you to see or do this.

not-found.title: Not found
not-found.body: This record does not exist in your agency scope.

partial.title: Some data is missing
partial.body: Part of this view could not be loaded. What is shown may be incomplete.

stale.title: This view may be out of date
stale.body: It was loaded a while ago. Refresh before you act on it.

upstream-failure.title: A service is unavailable
upstream-failure.body: The request could not be completed. Check the connection and try again.

conflict.title: The record has changed
conflict.body: Another action changed this record. Reload and review its current state.
